content.content:
Hey there! I'm looking to head to Paris from May 10th to May 13th and I need a hotel recommendation. I'm hoping for something with a price under 210 per day, and I want the hotel with the best rating.
            Also, I'm on the hunt for the best French cuisine restaurant for lunch on Sunday. Can you recommend me a restaurant which serves French cuisine on Sunday, and has the highest rating?
            Can you give me an estimate of the minimum cost for the trip? This includes the hotel for 3 days and meals for 2 per day at the restaurant.
            Looking forward to hearing your recommendations! Tell me the hotel name and the restaurant name.
            Thanks in advance.

```python
hotels_raw = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")
restaurants_raw = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

class NameList(BaseModel):
    names: list[str]

hotel_names_obj = query_ai_assistant(f"Extract the list of hotel names from the following text. Return only the names as a list.\n{hotels_raw}", NameList)
restaurant_names_obj = query_ai_assistant(f"Extract the list of restaurant names from the following text. Return only the names as a list.\n{restaurants_raw}", NameList)

hotel_names = hotel_names_obj.names
restaurant_names = restaurant_names_obj.names

hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotel_names)
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotel_names)
restaurant_cuisines = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)
restaurant_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)
restaurant_prices = get_price_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

hotel_data = {name: {"price": hotel_prices.get(name, "0"), "rating": hotel_ratings.get(name, "N/A")} for name in hotel_names}
restaurant_data = {name: {"cuisine": restaurant_cuisines.get(name, "N/A"), "rating": restaurant_ratings.get(name, "N/A"), "price": restaurant_prices.get(name, 0)} for name in restaurant_names}

class BestHotel(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price_per_day: float

class BestRestaurant(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price_per_person: float

best_hotel = query_ai_assistant(f"Select the best hotel from the following data that costs under 210 per day and has the highest rating. If there's a tie, choose the cheaper one. Return only the name and price per day.\nData: {str(hotel_data)}", BestHotel)
best_restaurant = query_ai_assistant(f"Select the best French cuisine restaurant from the following data that has the highest rating. If there's a tie, choose the cheaper one. Return only the name and price per person.\nData: {str(restaurant_data)}", BestRestaurant)

hotel_cost = best_hotel.price_per_day * 3
restaurant_cost = best_restaurant.price_per_person * 2 * 3
total_cost = hotel_cost + restaurant_cost

print(f"Recommended Hotel: {best_hotel.name} (${best_hotel.price_per_day}/day)")
print(f"Recommended Restaurant: {best_restaurant.name} (${best_restaurant.price_per_person}/person)")
print(f"Estimated Minimum Cost for the trip (3 days hotel, 3 days meals for 2): ${total_cost}")
```
